team via `users.parent_id`; `/manager/*` + extra mcp tools | | business sales agent | 4 | rep under a business agent | | admin | hq | internal staff; `/hq/*` and admin mcp only | details: [06-users-and-roles.md](06-users-and-roles.md). ## repos (do not mix them up) | path | what it is | |------|-----------| | `territool/` | react native mobile app | | `territool_web/webterritool/` | laravel web + dingo api + mcp modules + backpack hq | ## live urls | env | web / api | mcp (user) | |-----|-----------|------------| | production | `https://app.territool.com` | `https://app.territool.com/ai/mcp` | | staging | `https://staging.territool.com` | `https://staging.territool.com/ai/mcp` | | local web | `http://localhost:8888` (mamp; `.env` `app_url`) | `{app_url}/ai/mcp` | **mobile api base** (currently **prod** in `territool/app/config/index.js`): `https://app.territool.com/index.php/api/` staging (commented in the same file): `https://staging.territool.com/index.php/api/` ## auth at a glance - protected apis: `authorization: bearer {jwt}`. - mobile posts **formdata**. - some mcp/voice clients send json. - user mcp internally dispatches the same dingo `/api/v2` endpoints. see [12-mobile-api.md](12-mobile-api.md) and [14-mcp.md](14-mcp.md).

2.1 mobile (`territool/package.json`) requires **node >= 22.11.0**, java 17, ios 15.5+, android minsdk 24 / targetsdk 36. ```bash # install yarn install # postinstall: patch-package cd ios && pod install && cd .. # run yarn start # metro --reset-cache yarn start:fresh # kill :8081 then metro yarn ios yarn android yarn adb # adb reverse tcp:8081 # lint yarn lint yarn lint:fix # bundles yarn local_bundle # ios release jsbundle yarn local_bundle_android # clean yarn clean:node yarn clean:ios yarn clean:android yarn clean # all three # assets yarn link:assets # react-native-asset # postman from config yarn generate-collection yarn enrich-collection # git promotion (destructive to remotes — do not run unless asked) yarn merge:t2s # tt_80 → staging yarn merge:s2p # staging → production yarn merge:release ``` ### maestro e2e (`package.json` `maestro:*`) | script | notes | |-------|--------| | `maestro:login:staging:android` / `:ios` | `ann_new@yopmail.com` / `test@123` | | `maestro:login:live:android` / `:ios` | `testim@yopmail.com` / `test@123` | | `maestro:login:validation:android` | validation only | | `maestro:login:staging` / `:live` | both platforms | | `maestro:register:staging:android` / `:ios` | unique `maestro.stage.$(date +%s)@yopmail.com` | | `maestro:register:validation:android` | | | `maestro:post-register:onboarding:android` | | | `maestro:register:full-journey:android` | | flows live under `territool/.maestro/`. ### version fields | source | value | |--------|--------| | `package.json` `version` | `0.0.1` | | `package.json` `version_ios` | `7.1.49` | | `package.json` `version_android` | `4.2.7` | | android gradle (can drift) | `versionname` `4.4.70`, `versioncode` `361`, `applicationid` `com.picwa.territoolapp` | see [05-constraints-and-drift.md](05-constraints-and-drift.md). ## 2.2 web (`webterritool/package.json` + composer) php **^7.2**, laravel **^7.0**. local often mamp. ```bash composer install cp .env.example .env && php artisan key:generate # core tables often come from a sql dump, not a greenfield migrate npm install # or yarn npm run dev # vite (manager portal react + some vue 2) npm run build npm run serve # php artisan serve npm run queue # php artisan queue:listen --tries=3 --timeout=0 npm run clear # config/cache/compiled/view npm run clean npm run cleanyarn ``` composer post-install/update runs `php artisan optimize`. `composer.json` schedule is empty — **crons are http get routes**, not the laravel scheduler. see [13-web-urls.md](13-web-urls.md). ### user mcp artisan (`app/usermcp/console/`) command prefix is `territool-app` (matches the product name). ```bash php artisan territool-app:qa php artisan territool-app:selftest php artisan territool-app:qa-contacts php artisan territool-app:qa-search php artisan territool-app:logs ``` examples from the command classes: ```bash php artisan territool-app:selftest jane@example.com php artisan territool-app:selftest 437 --tool=view_routes php artisan territool-app:qa-contacts --user=784 php artisan territool-app:qa-search --user=784 php artisan territool-app:logs --user=156 --tool=create_route ``` admin mcp stdio: ```bash php artisan mcp:stdio ```
03-architecture.md: 03-architecture.md 03 architecture architecture and data flows --- id: 03-architecture parent: core sources: - territool/init.js - territool/app/app.js - webterritool/docs/mcp-manager-portal-feature-gap.md - "app/usermcp/services/tools/{account,companies,contacts,leads,manager,routes}tools.php" - app/usermcp related: - 10-mobile-app.md - 11-web-backend.md - 14-mcp.md - 18-cross-system-flows.md - appendix-c-footer-tabs.md - 07-vocabulary.md - 09-credits-billing.md - features/07-ai-find-leads.md --- # 3. architecture and data flows related: [10-mobile-app](10-mobile-app.md) · [11-web-backend](11-web-backend.md) · [14-mcp](14-mcp.md) · [18-cross-system-flows](18-cross-system-flows.md) ## 3.1 system map ``` field rep / manager ├── ios / android (react native) │ formdata + jwt ──► /index.php/api/{endpoint} │ realm (jwt, tours, ai cache, offline route blob) │ revenuecat ──► api revenuecate-success │ fcm / notifee, sentry, posthog, facebook sdk │ ├── browser (blade + jquery 2 + adminlte bs3) │ session cookie ──► routes/web.php │ manager portal: vite + react 18 under /manager/* │ hq: backpack /hq/* (admin only) │ └── ai clients (cursor / claude / chatgpt) oauth ──► user mcp /ai/mcp ──► dispatch /api/v2 as that user admin ──► /ai/mcp-admin (read-only territool db) find ──► /find-mcp/mcp (leads/contacts subset) laravel 7 ├── app/http/controllers web (companylcontroller ~8.5k loc) ├── app/api/v2/controllers mobile json ├── app/usermcp | adminmcp | findmcp ├── app/helpers/helpers.php helper:: geocode, save ai leads, credits ├── mysql (primary) + mongo (cities/geo via moloquent) └── stripe / paypal / revenuecat webhooks ``` ## 3.2 mobile startup ``` index.js └── import ./init.js att, sentry, posthog, crash handlers, fcm, facebook app id └── appregistry 'territool' → app/app.js app/app.js └── jwt realm id "1"? yes → revenuecat identify → free-trial? subscriptiongate : dashboard no → login ``` sources: `territool/index.js`, `territool/init.js`, `territool/app/app.js`. one **flat** `createnativestacknavigator()` — no nested stacks, no react navigation tabs. module switching is `customfooter` (`selectedindex` 1–6). see [appendix-c-footer-tabs.md](appendix-c-footer-tabs.md). ## 3.3 web request flow ``` browser → routes/web.php → middleware (auth, role, manager.only) → controller → model / helper → blade (or json for /manager/api/*) mobile → routes/api.php dingo v2 + jwt.refresh → api\v2\* → json ``` | middleware | class | behavior | |------------|-------|----------| | `role` | `checkuserrole` | admin → `/hq/dashboard`. sales / business / bsa stay in the app | | `manager.only` | `ensuremanagerrole` | only business agent on `/manager/*`; bsa → `/dashboard` | | `jwt.refresh` | `authjwt` | api auth group | ## 3.4 core field data flow ``` 1. find leads find_ai_leads / getaileadsv2 free (search) 2. save leads save_ai_leads / saveaileads 1 credit each (trial pkg 1 cap 60) 3. find contacts find_contacts / fetchallcontacts free (discovery) 4. buy contacts buy_contacts 2 paid / 1 free (claude/biz) 5. lists createlist free 6. route createroute / create_route free; mcp publishes + activates 7. drive next_waypoint, mark_visited free 8. log add_activity, add_note free ``` **saved vs new:** unsaved ai results are **leads**. saved address book rows are **companies**. never `search_companies` for brand-new prospects; never `add_company` for ai search hits (that skips credit + ai-save path). see [07-vocabulary.md](07-vocabulary.md) and [09-credits-billing.md](09-credits-billing.md). ## 3.5 ai find leads pipeline (web v2) ``` stage 1 gemini strategy planner territory + sell description → search_terms, filters stage 2 google places text search parallel terms, paging, dedupe, hard filters, sse stage 3 gemini refinement optional qualitative filter (reviews, specialties) persist user_ai_search save helper::saveailead → companies + used_credit ``` | client | sequence | |--------|----------| | web sse | `/ai-lead-finder/start\|stage1\|stage2\|stage3\|complete` + `get status` | | mobile | `getaileadsv2` → poll `resumeaileadsearch` / `getaileaddata` → `saveaileads` | **second engine:** manager portal places-circle hunt (`ai_search_by = manager_portal`) is **not** the same as user v2 city/zip. see `webterritool/docs/mcp-manager-portal-feature-gap.md` and [features/07-ai-find-leads.md](features/07-ai-find-leads.md). ## 3.6 mcp execution rule user mcp **does not reimplement** business logic. tools are either: - `api` passthrough mapped onto `/api/v2`, or - `handler` in `app/usermcp/services/tools/{account,companies,contacts,leads,manager,routes}tools.php` that still dispatches those apis. delete `app/usermcp` + unregister the provider to remove the customer mcp. full catalog: [14-mcp.md](14-mcp.md).

islands do **not** import it. | | tables | find leads + address book use **jqxgrid**. routes/lists index use datatables. | | chrome / tokens | [design-web/mini-design-brain.md](design-web/mini-design-brain.md). do not average classic leftover teal `#16aa9d` with manager `--teal`. do not “modernize” adminlte. | | mcp | short tool names/descriptions (chatgpt ~5000 token catalog). dispatch api; do not fork credit math. | | roles | spatie `hasroles` on `user`. manager scope = self + `parent_id`. | | migrations | do not assume greenfield migrate is enough. | ## 4.3 agents (cursor / claude / voice) - never invent leads, routes, credits, or company ids. - prefer screen/session context over re-asking. - credit spend: `get_credits` → quote cost → wait for explicit yes. [09-credits-billing.md](09-credits-billing.md) - cap save/route at **100** companies per action (trial save cap **60** on package id 1). - voice: ≤ 2 spoken sentences, no markdown/lists. [15-voice-policy.md](15-voice-policy.md) - coding agents: match the file’s existing pattern; do not “modernize” class screens or blade pages unless asked. web chrome: [design-web/mini-design-brain.md](design-web/mini-design-brain.md).

15-voice-policy.md: 15-voice-policy.md 15 voice policy voice agent policy --- id: 15-voice-policy parent: core related: - 07-vocabulary.md - 14-mcp.md - 04-style-guide.md --- # 15. voice agent policy related: [07-vocabulary](07-vocabulary.md) · [14-mcp](14-mcp.md) · [04-style-guide](04-style-guide.md) identity: territool voice — field assistant for the signed-in sales agent. tools only; no invented data. short speech over screen dumps. ## speak - at most two short sentences per turn. - no bullet lists, markdown, code, or json. - numbers under ten as words (five leads, two credits). ten and above as digits when helpful. - never say “next page,” “scroll down,” or “see the list.” summarize: count, first name, or ask which one. - prefer “done — water grill marked visited, four stops left.” ask at most one clarifying question. ## execute vs confirm **execute immediately:** view routes/lists/activities, next stop, mark visited, add note, add activity, search saved companies, find ai leads (search only), find contacts (discovery only), create list/route when the user clearly asked and ids are known. **confirm first:** `save_ai_leads`, `buy_contacts`. always `get_credits`, state exact cost and remaining balance, wait for an explicit yes. ## count-then-load ask area and business type if missing → `find_ai_leads` → speak the **count** → only then offer to save. do not dump dozens of names. ## 100 ceiling never save or route more than 100 companies in one action. if more exist, offer a cap (e.g. top twenty by rating) or ask how many. ## refer-back prefer screen / session context (active route, last company, last `search_id`) over asking again. if the user says “this one” or “that stop,” use the current stop or last mentioned company. ## skills **plan my day** (“plan my day”, “set up my run”): 1. ask area (city or zip) and business type. one question at a time. 2. count — `find_ai_leads` → resume until done → speak how many. 3. load — ask how many to save (default a small set; never over 100). `get_credits` → confirm → `save_ai_leads`. 4. find contacts? ask once. bulk or per-company find (free); buy only after confirm. 5. route — `create_route` with saved `company_ids` (or list). prefer gps start. 6. first stop — `next_waypoint` and speak name, short address, remaining count. if they already have a list or saved companies in that city, skip find/save: `search_companies` → `create_route` → `next_waypoint`. **log visit** (“i just saw x”): 1. resolve company (screen state first, else `search_companies`; if two matches, ask once). 2. `add_activity` `note_type: visit`, today’s date, short note. 3. if on an active route and x is the current/next stop, also `mark_visited`. 4. one-line confirm. do not use `add_note`. **next stop** (“what’s next”, “where am i going”): 1. if they finished the current stop, `mark_visited`. 2. `next_waypoint` (optional `route_id`, lat/lng). 3. speak company name, short street, remaining stops. no full route list. 4. if no active route: say so and offer to show routes or plan a day — do not invent stops.

design/01-Brand-Guidelines/Brand-Usage-R: design/01-brand-guidelines/brand-usage-rules.md brand usage rules brand usage rules (observed) --- id: brand-usage-rules parent: design --- # brand usage rules (observed) these rules are **descriptive**. they exist so a new screen matches territool as it ships today. ## do - use **`#124ac6`** for headers, selected footer, primary filled buttons, text links - use **din condensed bold** for titles/ctas and **regular** for body - use the **gradient header + curved `#f6f7fb` body (25pt)** pattern - put module switching in **customfooter** (6 icon tabs). dashboard is a **tile hub** without that footer - use **appconfirmmodal** instead of a native `alert` for confirms - use **toast** (`react-native-toast-message`) at the **top** for success/error/info - keep maps as full-bleed content under a blue header; numbered stop pins; locate + zoom fabs - keep empty copy centered, gray, with a short instructional sentence - keep dual-action sheets as **outline cancel + filled primary** (`share route`, `create new list`, `log out`) ## do not (based on current app) - do not introduce a react navigation tab/drawer navigator — the app is one **native stack** - do not introduce a dark app theme (qr camera is the only full-screen dark ui) - do not use inter even though ttfs exist - do not use `icon_lists.png` for the lists tab — live asset is `supply3.png` - do not assume address book company ctas match route-stop ctas: **add to** vs **mark** - do not silently “fix” mixed teal/green/gold chips or mixed danger hexes — copy the nearest screen ## voice / copy (from captures) - headers: “ai find leads”, “routes library”, “lists”, “address book”, “settings”, “scan business card”, “calendar activity” - ctas: “next step”, “confirm leads”, “create route”, “save list”, “add company”, “find contacts”, “mark visited” - empty: “no contacts found.” / “no activities yet.” / “no upcoming activities yet.” - loaders: “loading.”, “loading credits…”, “loading lists…”, “loading route on map…”, “generating your sales route”, “preparing route…” - fun fact on publish: “smart route planning saves 12% of fuel” (`route_publishing_sales_fun_fact`) ## deferred brand surfaces register, revenuecat paywall, subscriptiongate, settings plan paywall — **not documented visually** in this pass (`../06-coverage/deferred-scope.md`).

design/02-User-Interface/Navigation.md: design/02-user-interface/navigation.md navigation navigation --- id: navigation parent: design --- # navigation ## root - `@react-navigation/native` + `@react-navigation/native-stack` v7 - **no** bottom-tabs, drawer, or nested stacks - persistence key `@territool_nav_state` — restore **does not** reopen last deep screen (`initialstate` cleared) - `headershown: false` everywhere ## cold start ```mermaid flowchart td a[launch + js splash] --> b{jwt in realm?} b -->|no| l[login] b -->|yes| c[revenuecat identify] c --> d[get_credit_info trial] d --> e{trial inactive + sub not active?} e -->|yes| g[subscriptiongate - code live, pixels skipped] e -->|no or error| h[dashboard] ``` login success uses the same gate. gesture back disabled on login and dashboard. ## footer (not react navigation tabs) ```mermaid flowchart lr f[customfooter] --> t1[dashboard] f --> t2[push multipleaiwaypoint] f --> t3[listcompany] f --> t4[routes] f --> t5[lists] f --> t6[push editstatus] ``` find leads and settings **push**; others **navigate**. dashboard **does not render** the footer; home still targets dashboard. ios native **stack push animation** is visible in vid3 (`x3_t28s`): previous screen peeks from the left. ## module map (in-scope) ```mermaid flowchart tb dash[dashboard] dash --> ai[multipleaiwaypoint] dash --> scan[businesscard] dash --> addco[createcompany] dash --> r[routes] dash --> ls[lists] dash --> ab[listcompany] dash --> cal[calendaractivity] dash --> ra[recentactivity] dash --> qr[qrcodescanner] dash --> set[editstatus] ai --> cr[createroute] ai --> cl[createlists] cr --> sep[selectstartendpoints] sep --> pr[publishroute] pr --> rd[basicroutedetail] rd --> arm[activeroutemap] rd --> cv[companyview] arm --> wd[waypointdetail] ls --> ld[listsdetail] ld --> cv cl --> ld ab --> vc[viewcompany] ab --> addco ab --> cview[contactsview] ab --> cnew[contactscreate] vc --> editco[editcompany] vc --> cnew cv --> cnew cv --> cong[congcontact] cong --> biz[bizcontacts] ``` ## deep links / fcm - info.plist url scheme is facebook sdk, not in-app routing - referral dynamic link `https://territoolapp.page.link/app` is **share copy**, not a js router - fcm logs notification opens; **does not** `navigate("notifications")` **needs manual verification:** native firebase handling of dynamic links after install. ## dead / broken | name | issue | | --- | --- | | notifications | registered, never navigated | | routeswipe | registered, never navigated | | filterlist / filterroute / stack filtermodule | unused; design/05-Design-System/Usage-Rules.md: design/05-design-system/usage-rules.md usage rules usage rules for a new screen --- id: usage-rules parent: design sources: - app/app.js --- # usage rules for a new screen to look like territool **today**: 1. register a `stack.screen` in `app/app.js` (flat stack). 2. wrap with `customheader` (gradient) and `screencurvedbodystyles` (25pt `#f6f7fb`). 3. add `customfooter` with the correct `selectedindex` if it belongs to a module. 4. white cards, radius ~12, border `#e5e7eb`. 5. primary actions `#124ac6` radius 12 din bold; secondary outline 2px primary. 6. confirms via `appconfirmmodal`; async via top toast. 7. empty/loading/error states required (see states.md). 8. copy din condensed; do not introduce inter. 9. match **mark vs add to** to `parent_screen`. 10. do not “fix” teal/gold chips or mixed reds — copy the sibling screen. deferred: do not restyle register/paywall until that pack is in scope.

1. application overview territool is a **single native stack**. module switching is a custom **six-icon footer**, not react navigation tabs. dashboard is a **tile hub without the footer**. state is class-component local + realm jwt + asyncstorage. styling tokens live in `app/styles/theme.js` with many leftover hexes. ## 2. brand summary - primary **`#124ac6`** - body surface **`#f6f7fb`**, cards white, text `#111827` / `#6b7280` - custom font **din condensed** regular + bold — files in [`03-assets/fonts/`](03-assets/fonts/readme.md) (inter ttfs copied there too but unused) - logo: code uses `territool_logo_new.jpg`; testflight login/header show a **tt cube** — **needs manual verification** - no app-wide dark theme (qr scanner is dark) details: [`01-brand-guidelines`](01-brand-guidelines/readme.md) ## 3. design principles (observed) 1. blue gradient header + 25pt curved sheet 2. white rounded cards, 12px inputs 3. footer icon-only navigation 4. outline cancel + filled primary on dialogs 5. top toasts for async; appconfirmmodal for destructive 6. empty states are short gray instructions 7. context-specific company ctas (mark vs add to) ## 4. token summary see [`05-design-system/design-tokens.md`](05-design-system/design-tokens.md) and [`token-inconsistencies.md`](05-design-system/token-inconsistencies.md). **do not average inconsistencies.** ## 5. ui architecture `customheader` (lineargradient) → `primarybleed` → `curvedbody` → optional `customfooter`. maps and qr break the pattern (full map / dark camera). ## 6. navigation architecture flat stack, **46** screens (pack previously said 47). footer map and mermaid: [`02-user-interface/navigation.md`](02-user-interface/navigation.md). dead: notifications, routeswipe, stack filters. broken: `clusterlist`. code map: [`../screens/navigation-map.md`](../screens/navigation-map.md). ## features/07-ai-find-leads.md: features/07-ai-find-leads.md 07 ai find leads feature: ai find leads --- id: 07-ai-find-leads parent: features sources: - webterritool/docs/mcp-manager-portal-feature-gap.md - findleads/index.js related: - 03-architecture.md - 09-credits-billing.md - 14-mcp.md - screens/how-it-works.md - screens/navigation-map.md --- # feature: ai find leads related: [03-architecture](../03-architecture.md) · [09-credits-billing](../09-credits-billing.md) · [14-mcp](../14-mcp.md) · [navigation-map](../screens/navigation-map.md) ## what it does find unsaved businesses by city or zip and who the rep sells to. **search is free.** saving into the address book costs **1 credit each**. ## two engines (do not mix) | engine | who | how | |-------|--------|-----| | user v2 | sales agent / bsa / web findleads | gemini planner → places text search → optional gemini refine. territory city/zip | | manager portal | business agent `/manager/ai-find-leads` | places **circle** hunt (`ai_search_by = manager_portal`) | gap doc: `webterritool/docs/mcp-manager-portal-feature-gap.md`. ## pipeline (user v2) ``` stage 1 gemini strategy planner territory + sell description → search_terms, filters stage 2 google places text search parallel terms, paging, dedupe, hard filters stage 3 gemini refinement optional qualitative filter persist user_ai_search save helper::saveailead → companies + used_credit ``` web sse: `post ai-lead-finder/start|stage1|stage2|stage3|complete`, `get status`. keys: `gemini_api_key`, `google_key`. mobile: `multipleaiwaypoint` / `aifindleads.js` — `getaileadsv2` → `resumeaileadsearch` / `getaileaddata` → `saveaileads`. save needs **≥ 2** leads (`confirmleadsminmodalvisible`). post-save modal: add to a route, add to a list, or dashboard (address book only). onboarding skips that modal and goes to `createroute`. lists/routes **find leads** buttons open classic `multiplewaypoint` (places), **not** ai v2. do not mix the two engines. realm cache `aifindleads`: website, city, territorymode (`city`\|`zip`), selldetails, airesponse, aileads. nav: [screens/navigation-map.md](../screens/navigation-map.md). steps: [screens/how-it-works.md](../screens/how-it-works.md). ## other lead surfaces | feature | path | |--------|------| | classic map / lasso | `multiplewaypoint` / `findleads/index.js` (app ui; places) | | legacy | `getaileads`, `aileadgooglesearch` | | top 50 | `gettop50aileads` | | ai place contact counts | `aileadscontactfinder` | | yelp | web `getyelpleads` / `saveyelpleads`; hq `users.yelp_leads`. **not** in mobile config | trial package id **1** caps select at **60**. never save more than **100** in one action. ## mcp 1. `find_ai_leads` (free). in progress → `resume_ai_lead_search` **once**. 2. speak the **count**, do not dump names. 3. `save_ai_leads`: **always preview first** (even for 1 company). stop and wait. 4. after yes: `confirm_all=true` + `confirm_token`. 5. never `add_company` for these hits.

offline read via `getofflineroute`; share email | | `route/create.js` | select companies, name | | `route/edit.js` | edit; `smartcluster` branch | | `select-start-end-points.js` | start/end; `routetypestate` (`basic` / `smartcluster`) | | `publish-route.js` | `createroute` → poll `simplerouteview` until `published` | | `basic/index.js` `basicroutedetail` | waypoints, filters, share, active | | `basic/company-view.js` | hosts `customcompany` on route | | `basic/goswipe.js` | `routeswipe` | | `lassomap.js` | territory lasso | | `activeroutemap/index.js` | driving map + mapbox polylines | | `activeroutemap/waypointdetail.js` | stop detail | **no in-app pdf** on mobile (email share only). web has tcpdf/dompdf. `createofflineroute` has **no call sites**; screen-to-screen map: [navigation-map.md](navigation-map.md). ## rep happy path (ai → route → company → contacts) | step | screen | user | api / result | |------|--------|------|----------------| | 1 | dashboard or footer find leads | open hunt | expired sub may gate; dashboard region us/in/nz/au | | 2 | `multipleaiwaypoint` (`aifindleads.js`) | city/zip + ideal customer → search | `getusercredit`; `getaileadsv2` → poll `resumeaileadsearch` | | 3 | same | select **≥ 2** leads → next → confirm leads | `saveaileads` — **1 credit each**. min 2 (`confirmleadsminmodalvisible`) | | 4a | post-save modal | add to a **route** (create or existing) | `createroute` / edit path | | 4b | post-save modal | add to a **list** | `createlists` / lists | | 4c | post-save modal | return to dashboard | address book only | | 5 | `createroute` → `selectstartendpoints` | name, ≥2 waypoints, start ≠ end | `checkroutename` optional | | 6 | `publishroute` | auto on mount | `createroute` → poll `simplerouteview` until `route_status === "published"` | | 7 | `basicroutedetail` | tap company or map | `simplerouteview`; map → `activeroutemap` → `waypointdetail` | | 8 | `companyview` / `viewcompany` / `waypointdetail` | shared `customcompany` | `companydetail` / `getactiveroutecompany`, `companycontactlist`, `getcompanyactivities` | | 9 | find contacts | primary then claude/biz | `fetchallcontacts` free; empty → `fetchclaudecontact` → `bizcontacts`. buy: **2** paid / **1** claude. manual: `contactscreate` / `addcontact` free | | 10 | activity / mark | log or visit | `addcompanyactivity`; visit `companymarkedvisited` + `addcompanyvisittime`; unmark `companyvisitremove` | **onboarding:** register/login skips the post-save modal; ai screen goes straight to `createroute` with `firstsignuponboarding`. completes in `publishroute` via `setfirstsignuponboardingcomplete()`. **not ai:** lists/routes **find leads** open `multiplewaypoint` (`findleads/index.js`) — places, not `getaileadsv2`. ``` dashboard → multipleaiwaypoint → save ≥2 → createroute → selectstartendpoints → publishroute → basicroutedetail → companyview (customcompany) → congcontact / bizcontacts → activity / mark visited → next stop or activeroutemap ``` list-first branch: post-save → list → `selectstartendpointslist` → `publishroute` (`generateroute` or `createroute`). ## login (`login/index.js`) 1. user submits email/password. 2. formdata: `email`, `password`, `device_token`, `device_type` → `post login`. 3. on success: `createjwttoken("1", …)` in realm; seed `createtour("1")` and `createaifindleads("1")`. 4. revenuecat `identifyuser` `{userid}_{email}`. 5. `getusercredit` / free-trial → `subscriptiongate` **or** first-signup onboarding **or** `dashboard`. 6. forgot: modal `forgotpassword` with `email`; web link `{url_base.split("index")[0]}password/reset`. 7. 401/403 anywhere → `api.js` session expired → logout modal. ## publish route (`route/create/publish-route.js`) `createroute` is **async**. the ui polls until published. 1. build ordered company ids (start, middles, end). gps start only if start company id is `0`. 2. `post createroute` with `route_name`, `company_id_csv`, `resume_page=simpleroute/step1`, `routetype`, optional `latitude`/`longitude`, `filter_with`. 3. if `status == 1`, keep loader; store `route_id`. 4. after **2s**, `checkingstatus`: `post simplerouteview` with `page=0`, `route_id`, empty lat/lng. 5. if `data.data.route_status === "published"` → auto-navigate to route detail (unless user already left). 6. else `settimeout` **2s** and poll again. 7. `callmakerouteactive` can `post updaterouteactive` with `route_id`, then poll again. failure copy: “generating route failed!!” / network. do not treat `createroute` success as “ready to drive.” ## ai find leads v2 (`findleads/aifindleads.js`) 1. require territory (city or zip) + `sell_description`. 2. `post getaileadsv2` via `buildaiformdata({ ai_search_by, territories, sell_description, top50? })`. booleans become `"true"`/`"false"` strings. 3. read `search_id` and `strategy.needs_refinement` (drives a 60s countdown ui). 4. if `search_id`: `post resumeaileadsearch` with `{ search_id }`. company list is `response.data.company_list` (deduped by map). 5. cache in realm `aifindleads`. 6. save: each selected lead as `companies_data[]` json → `post saveaileads`. needs **≥ 2** selected (`confirmleadsminmodalvisible`). 7. `status == 1` with empty `insertedcompanydata` → toast that data could not be verified. ## find contacts (`customcompany` + `findcontactsfetchmodal`) 1. free discovery: `fetchallcontacts` with `company_id`, `domain`, `address`, `name`, `position`, `location`, `fullenrich_page`, `dataaxle_page`. 2. pagination: `lastreturnedkey` + `contact_count=true` + `domain` for apollo-style paging. 3. rows vs total: `fetchfirstcontactapi.js` supports both `{ data: [] }` and nested `{ data: { data: [] } }`. 4. buy: `buycontacts` / redeem endpoints — **2** paid / **1** claude. confirm credits first. ## mark visited / bookmark (`customcompany/index.js`) - visit time: `company_id`, `visit_time`, `route_id`, `flag`. - remove visit: `id` (visit id), `company_id`, plus `list_id` **or** `route_id`. - bookmark: `user_company_id`, `add` boolean, optional `list_id`/`route_id`. ## list → route (`list/create/select-start-end-points.js`) `generateroute`: `list_id`, `start_point`, `end_point`, optional gps if start is `0`. ## hubspot sync (`hubspotsyncflight.js`) only **one** companies/contacts/both sync at a time (`inflightpromise`). kind labels: `"compines"` (typo in code), `"contact"`, `"both"`. network error → wait for reachability and retry once. overlap shows toast “hubspot sync already in progress”. ## subscription gate (`subscriptiongate.js`) `get getusercredit`. `free_trial_status` classified active/inactive/unknown from several payload shapes. only **explicit inactive** should gate. also reads `is_subscription_expired`. ## web ai sse (`aileadfindercontroller`) `post /ai-lead-finder/start` then `stage1` (gemini) → `stage2` (places pages) → `stage3` (optional refine) → `complete`. browser `get status`. persist `user_ai_search`. manager portal uses a **different** places-circle engine. ## mcp `save_ai_leads` first call is always **preview** (no write). after user yes: `confirm_all=true` + `confirm_token`. never `add_company` for these hits.

[how to update this brain](#20-how-to-update-this-brain) --- ## 1. project overview territool is a field-sales crm: reps find businesses, save them to an address book, enrich decision-maker contacts (credits), group them into lists, build optimized driving routes, mark stops visited, and log activities. the same customer data is served by a react native ios/android app, a laravel 7 web app, a jwt `/api/v2` layer, and three mcp servers so cursor/claude/chatgpt can drive the product as the signed-in user. **who it is for** | role | `role_id` | what they do | |------|-----------|----------------| android (react native) │ formdata + jwt ──► /index.php/api/{endpoint} │ realm (jwt, tours, ai cache, offline route blob) │ revenuecat ──► api revenuecate-success │ fcm / notifee, sentry, posthog, facebook sdk │ ├── browser (blade + jquery 2 + adminlte bs3) │ session cookie ──► routes/web.php │ manager portal: vite + react 18 under /manager/* │ hq: backpack /hq/* (admin only) │ └── ai clients (cursor / claude / chatgpt) oauth ──► user mcp /ai/mcp ──► dispatch /api/v2 as that user admin ──► /ai/mcp-admin (read-only territool db) find ──► /find-mcp/mcp (leads/contacts subset) laravel 7 ├── app/http/controllers web (companylcontroller ~8.5k loc) ├── app/api/v2/controllers mobile json ├── app/usermcp | adminmcp | findmcp ├── app/helpers/helpers.php helper:: geocode, save ai leads, credits ├── mysql (primary) + mongo (cities/geo via moloquent) └── stripe / paypal / revenuecat webhooks ``` ### 3.2 mobile startup ``` index.js └── import ./init.js att, sentry, posthog, crash handlers, fcm, facebook app id └── appregistry 'territool' → app/app.js app/app.js └── jwt realm id "1"? yes → revenuecat identify → free-trial? subscriptiongate : dashboard no → login ``` one **flat** `createnativestacknavigator()` — no nested stacks, no react navigation tabs. module switching is `customfooter` (`selectedindex` 1–6). ### 3.3 web request flow ``` browser → routes/web.php → middleware (auth, role, manager.only) → controller → model / helper → blade (or json for /manager/api/*) mobile → routes/api.php dingo v2 + jwt.refresh → api\v2\* → json ``` `checkuserrole`: admin → `/hq/dashboard`. sales / business / bsa stay in the app. `ensuremanagerrole`: only business agent on `/manager/*`; bsa → `/dashboard`. ### 3.4 core field data flow ``` 1. find leads find_ai_leads / getaileadsv2 free (search) 2. save leads save_ai_leads / saveaileads 1 credit each (trial pkg 1 cap 60) 3. find contacts find_contacts / fetchallcontacts free (discovery) 4. buy contacts buy_contacts 2 paid / 1 free (claude/biz) 5. lists createlist free 6. route createroute / create_route free; mcp publishes + activates 7. drive next_waypoint, mark_visited free 8. log add_activity, add_note free ``` **saved vs new:** unsaved ai results are **leads**. saved address book rows are **companies**. never `search_companies` for brand-new prospects; never `add_company` for ai search hits (that skips credit + ai-save path). ### 3.5 ai find leads pipeline (web v2) ``` stage 1 gemini strategy planner territory + sell description → search_terms, filters stage 2 google places text search parallel terms, paging, dedupe, hard filters, sse stage 3 gemini refinement optional qualitative filter (reviews, specialties) persist user_ai_search save helper::saveailead → companies + used_credit ``` web sse: `/ai-lead-finder/start|stage1|stage2|stage3|complete` + `get status`. mobile: `getaileadsv2` → poll `resumeaileadsearch` / `getaileaddata` → `saveaileads`. **second engine:** manager portal places-circle hunt (`ai_search_by = manager_portal`) is **not** the same as user v2 city/zip. see `docs/mcp-manager-portal-feature-gap.md`. ### 3.6 mcp execution rule user mcp **does not reimplement** business logic. tools are either: - `api` passthrough mapped onto `/api/v2`, or - `handler` in `app/usermcp/services/tools/{account,companies,contacts,leads,manager,routes}tools.php` that still dispatches those apis. delete `app/usermcp` + unregister the provider to remove the customer mcp. --- ## 4. style guide ### 4.1 mobile | rule | do this | |------|---------| | components | almost all **class** `component` / `purecomponent` / `validationcomponent`. do not casually convert screens to hooks. | | nativebase | **removed.** use `app/utils/nativebasecompat.js`. do not add `native-base`. (`fonts26`, `flx1`, `padt20`, …). | | names | `url_*` endpoints, `color_*` colors, pascalcase screens, camelcase utils, `_prefix` private global fields. | | errors | `capturesentryerror(screen, action)`. 401/403 → session logout. | | testids | `screen.*`, `footer.*`, `modal.*` | | lists | `keyextractor`; `purecomponent` row; recyclerlistview for large lists. | | patches | `patch-package` postinstall. | | config | **one file:** `app/config/index.js`. prod vs staging = comment-swap `url_base`. no `.env` flavor matrix. | | nav | register every screen in `app/app.js`. do not introduce nested navigators. | | comments | only when the why is non-obvious. | **color drift:** `prompts/territool_overview.md` cites teal `#12a090`; live `app/styles/theme.js` primary is `#124ac6`. prefer the live theme file. ### 4.2 web | rule | do this | |------|---------| | php | laravel 7 style. giant controllers are the norm (`companylcontroller` is spelled with the extra **l**). new company/lead/contact work often lands there — be surgical. | | helpers | autoloaded `app/helpers/helpers.php` → `app\helpers\helper`. do not confuse with `app\globals\helper`. | | requests | companylcontroller aliases `request as input_request`. | | front (classic) | blade + **jquery 2.2.0** + bootstrap 3 adminlte. ajax often `formdata` with `contenttype: false`, `processdata: false`. | | front (manager) | vite + react 18 + bootstrap 5 + leaflet. do not assume the classic blade stack there. | | tables | find leads page uses **jqxgrid**. | | mcp | short tool names/descriptions (chatgpt ~5000 token catalog). dispatch api; do not fork credit math. | | roles | spatie `hasroles` on `user`. manager scope = self + `parent_id`. | | migrations | do not assume greenfield migrate is enough. | ### 4.3 agents (cursor / claude / voice) - never invent leads, routes, credits, or company ids. - prefer screen/session context over re-asking. - credit spend: `get_credits` → quote cost → wait for explicit yes. - cap save/route at **100** companies per action (trial save cap **60** on package id 1). - voice: ≤ 2 spoken sentences, no markdown/lists (see §15). - coding agents: match the file’s existing pattern; do not “modernize” class screens or blade pages unless asked. --- ## 5. durable facts, constraints, known drift ### 5.1 constraints | constraint | fact | |------------|------| | **confirm first:** `save_ai_leads`, `buy_contacts`. **count-then-load:** ask area + business type → search → speak **count** → then offer to save. do not dump dozens of names. **100 ceiling:** never
